international.title: Israeli parliament elects new Knesset speaker backed by Netanyahu’s opponents
international.summary: Appointment of Matan Kahana marks step towards reversing policies of Netanyahu’s outgoing government The Israeli parliament elected a new speaker on Tuesday, a key step toward rolling back policies passed by the outgoing government led by the prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu. The new speaker is Matan Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot , the party leader currently working to form the next government and replace Netanyahu . Eisenkot’s bloc has pledged to undo some of Netanyahu’s most contentious policies following Kahana’s election. Continue reading...
